user.title: Tuya IR Remotes
user.description: Access ID and Access Secret of a cloud project on platform.tuya.com with the IR Control Hub Open Service authorized and your Smart Life / Tuya app account linked. Data center: the one chosen for that project (eu = Central Europe).

reauth_confirm.title: Tuya refused the credentials
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the Access ID and Access Secret of the Tuya cloud project again.

error.invalid_auth: Tuya refused the Access ID or Access Secret, or the data center is wrong.
error.trial_expired: The free trial of the Tuya cloud project has expired. Extend it on platform.tuya.com (Cloud → Cloud Services → IoT Core).
error.no_hubs: No linked device has IR remotes. Link your app account to the project and check that the IR Control Hub Open Service is authorized.

abort.already_configured: This IR blaster is already configured.

trial_expired.title: Tuya cloud trial expired
trial_expired.description: The free IoT Core trial of your Tuya cloud project has expired, so the IR remotes cannot send keys. On platform.tuya.com go to Cloud → Cloud Services → IoT Core → Extend Trial Period, then reload the Tuya IR Remotes integration.
